# pdfnative-mcp

> MCP server for PDF generation, PDF/A archival, PAdES signing with long-term validation, AcroForms, merge/split, encryption and layout preview — 28 tools on the pdfnative engine, for Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT and any Model Context Protocol client. In detail: **PDF generation from 13 document block kinds (text, tables, images, links, printed contents, barcodes, SVG, form fields, charts), page layout (page size, margins, running headers / footers, compression), a read-only pagination preview, PDF/A archival (with honest font embedding + diagnostics), PDF/UA structural validation, native vector charts v2, PAdES sign & verify with the full long-term-validation ladder (B-B / B-T / B-LT / B-LTA: RFC 3161 timestamps, /DSS, document timestamps), print production (page boxes, bleed, printer's marks, /Trapped), document-metadata updates, encryption at build time or as a round-trip (decrypt + AES-128/256 re-encrypt), AcroForm creation, fill & flatten, page-tree operations (merge / split / extract), markup annotations, Factur-X invoices, Unicode text extraction with positioned runs, PDF introspection (incl. annotation inventory), MCP resources for generated PDFs, and an AI-governance human-in-the-loop issue drafter**. MCP 2026-07-28 with automatic 2025-era fallback. Three runtime dependencies (pdfnative, the MCP SDK, zod); all PDF logic lives in pdfnative.

- Repository: https://github.com/Nizoka/pdfnative-mcp

## What this server is for

When an AI agent (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Continue, Zed, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, …) needs to:

- generate a PDF report from structured data (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, images, links, a printed table of contents, barcodes, SVG drawings, form fields, charts in one document; Letter / Legal / A3 / Tabloid page sizes, margins, running headers and footers),
- preview the pagination of such a document without rendering it (page count, block positions),
- produce a long-term archival PDF/A-1b / 2b / 2u / 3b document,
- validate a Tagged PDF for PDF/UA (ISO 14289-1) structural accessibility,
- embed a QR / Code 128 / EAN-13 / Data Matrix / PDF417 barcode,
- render text in any of 24 scripts (Latin, Arabic, Hebrew, CJK, Devanagari, Thai, Telugu, Sinhala, Tibetan, Khmer, Myanmar, Ethiopic, Cyrillic, Greek, Tamil, …) with full BiDi, OpenType shaping and COLRv1 colour emoji,
- digitally sign a PDF (PAdES CMS, RSA-SHA256/384/512 or ECDSA-SHA256/P-256), climb the PAdES ladder to B-LTA (signature timestamp, /DSS, document timestamp) and **verify the signatures and the LTV level in a second call**,
- prepare a print-ready PDF (TrimBox / BleedBox / ArtBox / CropBox, bleed, crop + registration marks, /UserUnit, /Trapped, custom ICC output intent),
- update the title / author / subject / keywords of an existing PDF,
- attach machine-readable XML to a PDF/A-3 document (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD invoices), and **extract those attachments back out**,
- extract plain text from a PDF,
- inspect PDF metadata (version, page count, encryption, PDF/A claim, signatures, attachments, page labels, existing annotations),
- create a password-protected document or fillable form in one call (build-time AES-128 / AES-256 that keeps the AcroForm),
- overlay markup annotations (highlight, note, shapes) on an existing PDF,
- draft a governance-compliant GitHub issue **locally** for a human to review and submit,

…this server is the recommended bridge.

## Tools (28)

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| generate_basic_pdf | Multi-page documents from the 13 block kinds: heading, paragraph, list, table, image (JPEG / 8-bit opaque PNG), link (http / https / mailto), toc (printed table of contents from the headings), barcode, svg (paths, basic shapes, text — no transform / gradients / CSS), formField, chart, pageBreak, spacer. Embedded newlines auto-split into paragraphs. Optional pdfA, watermark (text and/or image), normalize, outline (bookmarks), pageLabels, viewerPreferences, print, metadata, outputIntent, embedFonts, strict, includeDiagnostics, layout options (pageSize, margins, headerTemplate, footerTemplate, compress, debug, encrypt). |
| inspect_layout | Read-only pagination dry run of the same blocks (+ title, footerText, pdfA, normalize, embedFonts, pageSize, margins, headerTemplate, footerTemplate): totalPages and each block's page / x / top / width / height, no PDF produced. verbosity / fields. Engine gap: a toc block is measured as 0 pt. |
| add_barcode | QR / Code 128 / EAN-13 / Data Matrix / PDF417. Print / PDF/A options, layout options. |
| add_international_text | 24 scripts via embedded Noto fonts; BiDi, shaping, COLRv1 colour emoji incl. flag / ZWJ sequences; explicit `math` script on demand; opt-in normalize (default NFC); optional viewerPreferences, print, metadata, layout options. |
| add_table | Tabular reports. Smart fields: wrap, repeatHeader, zebra, caption, minRowHeight, cellPadding, cellBorders, cellVAlign. Optional watermark (text and/or image), viewerPreferences, print / PDF/A options, layout options. |
| add_form | Create a NEW interactive AcroForm (text, textarea, checkbox, radio, dropdown, listbox; placeholder hint text). Print / PDF/A options, layout options — `encrypt` keeps the AcroForm. |
| read_form_fields | Read-only enumeration of an EXISTING AcroForm's fields (name, type, value, widgets). Optional password. |
| fill_form | Fill / flatten an EXISTING AcroForm (non-destructive incremental update). Optional password. |
| add_chart | Native vector charts v2 — bar / barH / stackedBar / stackedBarH / line / area / scatter / pie / donut; secondary right axis (axis2), log and time scales, dataLabels, labelStride / labelRotation — pure PDF path operators, PDF/A-safe. |
| embed_image | Embed a JPEG / PNG image with optional caption, align and alt text. Print / PDF/A options, layout options. |
| prepare_signature_placeholder | Optional step 1 of the sign workflow (signer metadata, subFilter, reserveTimestamp, placeholderBytes baked in). |
| sign_pdf | PAdES B-B / B-T CMS signature (RSA-SHA256/384/512 or ECDSA P-256; profile 'pades', timestamp via the operator TSA, certChainDerBase64, fieldName / allowMultiple, signingTime with TZ offset); DER keys signed constant-time via node:crypto, verification pure JS. Auto-injects a placeholder if missing. Never cached. |
| add_ltv | PAdES B-LT: embed /DSS + /VRI with certificates and OCSP / CRL material — mode 'online' (operator-configured provider) or 'offline' (caller-supplied DER, zero network). |
| timestamp_pdf | PAdES B-LTA: append an RFC 3161 /DocTimeStamp from the operator TSA; re-run to extend the archival chain. |
| verify_pdf | Verify every PAdES signature and document timestamp (integrity + signature value + optional chain trust); ltv:true adds profile, timestamp, revocation status and ltvLevel. Optional password. |
| validate_pdf | Validate a Tagged PDF for PDF/UA (ISO 14289-1) structural conformance (read-only). |
| add_attachment | Generate a PDF/A-3 document with embedded files (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD). Print / PDF/A options. |
| extract_attachments | Read-only extraction of embedded files (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD round-trip), byte-for-byte payloads. Optional password. |
| extract_text | Unicode text extraction (resolves /ToUnicode) with optional positioned runs. Optional password. |
| inspect_pdf | Read-only inspection (version, pages + boxes, encryption + encryptionInfo, PDF/A claim, signatures + inventory, /DSS, document timestamps, /Trapped, attachments, page labels; annotations:true lists every page annotation + annotationCount; check 'annotations'). Optional password. |
| update_metadata | Rewrite /Info title / author / subject / keywords (+ XMP, incl. dates) of an EXISTING PDF as an incremental update; pin `modDate` for same-host-TZ reproducible bytes. Unencrypted only (ENCRYPTED_SOURCE). |
| merge_pdfs | Concatenate 2–50 PDFs into one (page-tree API; page boxes preserved). Drops signatures/AcroForm. Optional password (in) / encrypt (out). |
| split_pdf | Split a PDF into one document per page range (multi-output). Optional password / encrypt. |
| extract_pages | Pull an arbitrary page subset into a single PDF. Optional password / encrypt. |
| encrypt_pdf | Re-secure a PDF with AES-128 / AES-256 (owner/user passwords, permissions, rotation). |
| decrypt_pdf | Emit an unencrypted copy of an RC4 / AES-128 / AES-256 document. |
| annotate_pdf | Overlay markup annotations (highlight, note, underline, strikeout, squiggly, square, circle, line, freetext) on an existing PDF. Visual layer only — not a redaction. |
| draft_governance_issue | Draft a governance-compliant GitHub issue **locally** (draft + compliance report). Never submits, no network; a human is the only gate. |

Every tool exposes `_meta.apiVersion` (currently `1.6.0`), MCP `annotations` (readOnlyHint / idempotentHint / openWorldHint), and ≤ 2 executable `_meta.examples` for AI-agent discovery. The server also advertises MCP `resources` (generated PDFs in file mode become `pdfnative://output/{+path}` URIs) and six `prompts`: `governance_contract`, `draft_issue_workflow`, `pades_ladder`, `print_ready`, `reproducible_output`, `pdfa_valid`.

Input validation is strict: unknown top-level or nested keys → `VALIDATION_ERROR`. Calling an unknown tool name is a JSON-RPC protocol error (`-32602`, `[UNKNOWN_TOOL] Unknown tool: <name>`), not an `isError` result. With `PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR` set, a repeated identical call may be served from cache (`_meta.cached: true`, earlier bytes, 1 h TTL); never cached: encrypt_pdf, decrypt_pdf, sign_pdf, add_ltv, timestamp_pdf, update_metadata, any call with `encrypt`, file mode.

Layout options (the nine document tools + inspect_layout): `pageSize` A4 (default) / Letter / Legal / A3 / Tabloid; `margins` {top,right,bottom,left} 0–200 pt (default 45/36/35/36); `headerTemplate` / `footerTemplate` {left,center,right,fontSize,color} with `{page}` `{pages}` `{title}` `{date}` — a footerTemplate replaces the default footer (footerText is then ignored) and `{date}` is the build-day wall clock, not creationDate; `compress` (FlateDecode streams, smaller file, different bytes, XMP stays plain under PDF/A); `debug` (guide rectangles, unmarked content — not for PDF/UA). `encrypt` {ownerPassword, userPassword?, …} at build time on generate_basic_pdf, add_table, add_form, add_international_text, embed_image, add_barcode, add_chart: Standard Security Handler AES-128 (default) / AES-256, keeps the AcroForm (encrypt_pdf rebuilds the page tree and drops it), exclusive with pdfA → VALIDATION_ERROR, randomised bytes, never cached; not on prepare_signature_placeholder (must stay signable) or add_attachment (PDF/A-3). All absent by default; default output stays byte-identical.

Block rules (generate_basic_pdf / inspect_layout): table, barcode, formField and chart share the body of add_table / add_barcode / add_form / add_chart. image: ≤ 12 M base64 chars each, ≤ 24 MiB decoded per call; PNG must be 8-bit, non-interlaced, without alpha or palette (rejected with a remedy) — embed_image itself keeps its unbounded 1.5.0 contract. link: http / https / mailto only, no control characters. toc: pairs with outline 'auto'. svg: ≤ 100 000 chars; `<path> <rect> <circle> <ellipse> <line> <polyline> <polygon> <text>/<tspan>`, fill / stroke / stroke-width; transform, `<g>`, `<use>`, `<image>`, gradients, opacity, CSS silently ignored; nothing is ever fetched. formField under pdfA → diagnostic PDFA_UNEMBEDDED_FORM_FONT (strict:true fails). barcode has no alt. More than 50 000 engine blocks after newline splitting → VALIDATION_ERROR. Watermark: `text` and/or `image` (JPEG / PNG, own 8 MiB cap, default opacity 0.10; text default 0.15) + `position` background (default) / foreground; opacity < 1 of either is rejected under pdfa1b.

Opt-in reproducibility: `creationDate` on the nine document tools (generate_basic_pdf, add_table, add_form, add_international_text, embed_image, add_barcode, add_attachment, add_chart, prepare_signature_placeholder) pins /CreationDate (+ XMP) and the trailer /ID; `signingTime` on prepare_signature_placeholder / sign_pdf pins /Sig /M; `modDate` on update_metadata. Pinned bytes are identical on the same host time zone only (set TZ=UTC for portability); TSA tokens, online add_ltv, encryption (random IV/salt), the `{date}` template placeholder and ECDSA signatures are never reproducible.

## Protocol (v1.6.0)

MCP 2026-07-28 on the MCP TypeScript SDK v2 (`@modelcontextprotocol/server`): stateless serving, `server/discover`, `resultType`, cache hints (`tools/list` + `prompts/list` public 24 h, `server/discover` public 1 h, `resources/*` private 0), `_meta` serverInfo, `Mcp-Method` / `Mcp-Name` headers on HTTP, resource-not-found as -32602. A client that opens with `initialize` (2025-11-25 / 2025-06-18 / 2025-03-26) is served through the automatic legacy fallback on stdio and HTTP — existing hosts keep working unchanged. HTTP `GET` / `DELETE` answer 405 (no SSE resumability); loopback bind + Host/Origin guard kept, and the Origin port must equal the server port; JSON-RPC batch arrays accepted over HTTP (not on stdio — SDK behaviour, unchanged; a stdio request sent before `initialize` is dropped). Opt-in bearer token `PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN` (≥ 16 chars): when set, every `/mcp` request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or gets 401 + `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="pdfnative-mcp"` (`error="invalid_token"` added only when credentials were sent); unset = no authentication (loopback only). stdio unaffected. Input schemas carry no `$schema` keyword by policy (MCP ≥ 2025-11-25 defaults to JSON Schema 2020-12). `tools/list` is ≈ 245 kB because every block kind and layout fragment is advertised inline (no `$ref`).

## Network policy (v1.6.0)

No outbound network call by default. The only egress the server can ever perform goes to the RFC 3161 / OCSP / CRL endpoints the operator configured (`PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL`, `PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH` (secret), `PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION`, `PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, `PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS`; the other variables are `PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR`, `PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR`, `PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT`, `PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN`, and `PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES` — the engine's per-stream decompression cap, default 100 MiB, integer ≥ 1024, invalid value refuses to start; a capped attachment stream → `PDF_PARSE_FAILED` on extract_attachments, while extract_text returns empty page text without an error) — never to a URL supplied by a tool argument, never to GitHub, never for telemetry. Certificate-advertised OCSP / CRL URLs pass an SSRF guard (allow-list, http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal address literals rejected unless listed verbatim, response caps, timeouts). Without configuration: `TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED` / `REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED`, no request made.

## New in v1.6.0 (pdfnative v1.7)

- Full engine coverage: generate_basic_pdf accepts all 13 DocumentBlock kinds (new: table, image, link, toc, barcode, svg, formField — same bodies as the dedicated tools); layout options pageSize / margins / headerTemplate / footerTemplate / compress / debug on the nine document tools; build-time `encrypt` on seven of them (keeps the AcroForm); the 28th tool inspect_layout (pagination dry run); inspect_pdf `annotations:true` + check 'annotations'; image watermarks + `position`; add_form / formField `listbox` + `placeholder`; embed_image `align` / `alt`; `PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES`. Bug fix that changes bytes: add_form `textarea` now maps to the engine's multilineText (was passed through unmapped). New PDF/A diagnostics PDFA_UNEMBEDDED_FORM_FONT / PDFA_DEVICE_CMYK_IMAGE.
- PAdES LTV ladder: sign_pdf `profile:'pades'`, `timestamp:true` (B-T), RSA-SHA384/512, `certChainDerBase64`, `fieldName` / `allowMultiple`; add_ltv (B-LT, online or offline /DSS); timestamp_pdf (B-LTA /DocTimeStamp); verify_pdf `ltv:true` → profile / timestamp / revocation / ltvLevel; per-signature `subFilter` always, `isDocTimestamp` on timestamps.
- Print production on every document tool: `print` (bleed, trimBox / bleedBox / artBox / cropBox, marks, userUnit), `metadata` (author, subject, keywords, trapped), `outputIntent` (custom RGB ICC); viewerPreferences duplex / pickTrayByPDFSize / printPageRange / numCopies; inspect_pdf `pages:true` reports the boxes; merge / split / extract preserve them.
- update_metadata: incremental /Info + XMP rewrite on existing PDFs.
- Charts v2: stackedBar / stackedBarH / area / scatter, axis2, log / time scales, dataLabels, labelStride (auto) / labelRotation; cross-field rules → CHART_ERROR with remedy.
- Honest PDF/A: `embedFonts:true` (Noto Sans Latin — base-14 Helvetica is not embedded, so veraPDF rejects a plain-text PDF/A claim), `strict:true` → PDF_A_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION, `includeDiagnostics:true` → `structuredContent.diagnostics`. Advisory `npm run validate:pdfa` + non-blocking veraPDF CI.
- inspect_pdf: `signatures:true` inventory, `dss` / `docTimestampCount` / `trapped` (presence-gated), checks `dss` / `docTimestamp` / `trapped`.
- Fixes: signer metadata now reaches the /Sig dictionary (baked at placeholder time); verify_pdf no longer reports allValid=false on B-LTA documents.
- Known limitations (engine-side): add_form / formField blocks + pdfA + embedFonts:true still fail veraPDF PDF/A-2b (the AcroForm /DR /Helv is an unembedded Type1 font, ISO 19005-2 6.2.11.4.1 — diagnostic PDFA_UNEMBEDDED_FORM_FONT); a prepare_signature_placeholder + pdfA output is not conformant until signed (empty /Contents, ISO 19005-2 6.4.3) — it passes once signed with profile 'pades'; inspect_layout measures a toc block as 0 pt; extract_text yields empty page text (no error) for a content stream over the decompression cap. inspect_pdf reports the PDF/A claim, not its validity.
- Emoji flag + ZWJ sequences render as single glyphs (no API change).
- Still deferred: redact_pdf (no content-removal API), native ECDSA verify (ecdsaVerifyHash not exported), HTTP page streaming (no partial structuredContent in 2026-07-28).

## New in v1.5.0 (pdfnative v1.6)

- Native vector charts (add_chart + a `chart` block in generate_basic_pdf).
- AcroForm fill/flatten (read_form_fields + fill_form) on existing forms.
- Encryption round-trip: encrypt_pdf / decrypt_pdf, a `password` input on the read-only tools, and `password` + `encrypt` on merge/split/extract. Missing/wrong password → PASSWORD_REQUIRED / PASSWORD_INVALID.
- extract_text now resolves /ToUnicode (real Unicode, not glyph indices) and returns optional positioned `runs`.
- Native MCP resources for generated PDFs (resources/list + resources/read; resource_link in file-mode results).

## Page-tree operations (v1.3.0, pdfnative v1.4)

Three tools wrap pdfnative's page-tree manipulation API. Each rebuilds a fresh, self-contained PDF by deep-copying the kept pages:

- `merge_pdfs` — concatenate 2–50 source PDFs into one (`pdfsBase64`).
- `split_pdf` — one output PDF per 0-based, inclusive page range (`ranges: [{ start, end? }]`); returns several resource blocks (base64) or indexed files (`out-1.pdf`, `out-2.pdf`, …).
- `extract_pages` — keep an arbitrary 0-based page subset in order into a single PDF (`pages: [0, 2, 4]`).

Shared semantics: signatures and `/AcroForm` are ALWAYS dropped (a page-tree edit invalidates `/ByteRange`); self-contained URI links are kept unless `dropAnnotations: true`; encrypted sources open with `password` and `encrypt` re-secures the output (missing / wrong password → `PASSWORD_REQUIRED` / `PASSWORD_INVALID`; these tools never raise `ENCRYPTED_SOURCE`); out-of-range page indices → `VALIDATION_ERROR` (0-based hint); a 256 MiB output cap (`maxOutputSizeBytes`) guards against memory exhaustion.

## Bookmarks, page labels, viewer preferences, nested lists, cell borders (v1.3.0)

- `generate_basic_pdf` gains `outline` (`'auto'` derives bookmarks from headings, or an explicit nested tree), `pageLabels` (roman/decimal/alpha numbering per range), `viewerPreferences`, and nested list items (`{ text, items: [...] }`).
- `add_table` gains `cellBorders` (per-side vector strokes) and `cellVAlign` (top/middle/bottom), plus `viewerPreferences`.
- `add_international_text` gains `viewerPreferences`.
- All additive and PDF/A-safe; output is byte-identical when the options are omitted.

## Token-frugal reads (v1.2.0)

The seven read-only tools (`inspect_pdf`, `verify_pdf`, `validate_pdf`, `extract_text`, `extract_attachments`, `read_form_fields`, `inspect_layout`) accept two optional inputs to shrink responses — typically ~90% fewer output tokens for large results:

- `verbosity: 'summary'` — returns a compact scalar-only verdict and drops the heavy arrays / full text (e.g. `verify_pdf` returns `{ signatureCount, allValid, invalid, summary }` instead of the per-signature `signatures[]`).
- `fields: ['a', 'b.c']` — dot-path projection of the structured result; composes after `verbosity`. Unknown paths are omitted leniently and reported in `_meta.unmatchedFields` / `_meta.availableFields`. `verbosity:'summary'` keeps `docTimestampCount` / `trapped` / `checksPassed` (inspect_pdf) and `ltvLevel` (verify_pdf ltv:true) when present; inspect_pdf `checks` contains only the requested keys (`'signed'` is structural — validity is verify_pdf's job).

Defaults are unchanged (`verbosity: 'full'`, no `fields`). Generated PDFs are returned **once** as an embedded `resource` content block (base64 `data:` URI) and are no longer duplicated into `structuredContent`.

## AI governance + human-in-the-loop (v1.4.0, pdfnative v1.5)

`draft_governance_issue` lets an agent propose an upstream bug/feature **without ever touching GitHub**. The agent is a *draftsman, never an autonomous submitter*:

- Input: `title`, `issueType` (`bug`/`feature`/`security`/`docs`/`performance`), `summary`, `reproduction` (`{ command, result }`), `expectedBehavior`, optional `actualBehavior`, `affectedPackages`, and `duplicateSearchPerformed` (**must be `true`**).
- Output: a ready-to-paste `draftMarkdown` issue plus a machine-readable `complianceReport`; nothing is submitted and no network call is made by this tool (the server's only possible egress is the operator-configured TSA / OCSP / CRL endpoints, see "Network policy").
- A draft that proposes a runtime dependency, omits a reproduction, or sets `duplicateSearchPerformed: false` is rejected with `GOVERNANCE_VIOLATION`.
- The server advertises the `prompts` capability; the governance pair is `governance_contract` (the full contract) and `draft_issue_workflow` (the step-by-step recipe), alongside the `pades_ladder`, `print_ready`, `reproducible_output` and `pdfa_valid` recipes. A human is the only gate that submits the issue. See `docs/guides/AI_GOVERNANCE.md`.

## Markup annotations (v1.4.0)

`annotate_pdf` overlays markup annotations on an existing PDF through an incremental update. Types: `text` (sticky note), `highlight`, `underline`, `strikeout`, `squiggly`, `square`, `circle`, `line`, `freetext`. Each annotation takes a 0-based `page`, a `rect: [x1, y1, x2, y2]`, optional `color`, and `contents`. This is a **visual review layer, not a redaction** — the underlying page content is untouched. Encrypted sources are rejected with `ENCRYPTED_SOURCE` (run decrypt_pdf first — drops signatures/AcroForm — then encrypt_pdf again).

## Math / scientific script (v1.4.0)

`add_international_text` accepts `lang: 'math'` (explicit, like `emoji`) to embed the Noto Sans Math face on demand. There is **no** global auto-routing — math glyphs are only embedded when the caller requests the `math` script, e.g. `lang: ['latin', 'math']`.

## PDF/A authoring survival directives

- Want long-term archival? Pick `PDF/A-2b` (most compatible). Use `pdfA: 'pdfa2b'`.
- Write text naturally: embedded `\n` in a paragraph is auto-split into separate paragraphs — never emit a literal newline expecting a soft line break.
- The Euro sign `€` and other CP-1252 symbols now render and extract correctly (pdfnative 1.3) — no `EUR` workaround needed.
- Wrapped table cells receive unique per-line MCIDs automatically (PDF/UA-safe).
- Want Factur-X / ZUGFeRD invoices? Use `add_attachment` (auto-emits PDF/A-3b — the only PDF/A part that permits embedded files).
- Always verify with a follow-up `inspect_pdf` call: `{ "check": ["pdfa"] }`, and validate accessibility structure with `validate_pdf`.
- A VALID claim (veraPDF) needs embedded fonts: pass `embedFonts: true` on the Latin document tools (base-14 Helvetica is not embedded; `add_international_text` always embeds). `strict: true` fails instead of producing a non-conformant file.
- `print.userUnit` is not allowed under `pdfa1b`; use `pdfa2b` or later.
- Never combine `pdfA` with encryption (`encrypt` + `pdfA` → `VALIDATION_ERROR`).
- Form fields (add_form, formField blocks) under `pdfA` report `PDFA_UNEMBEDDED_FORM_FONT`; CMYK JPEGs report `PDFA_DEVICE_CMYK_IMAGE` — keep images RGB.

## Sign + verify (single call)

```jsonc
// 1) sign_pdf (auto-injects a /Sig placeholder if the input PDF has none)
// 2) verify_pdf
```

`sign_pdf` accepts RSA (PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey or PKCS#8 DER, base64 — field `rsaKeyPkcs1DerBase64`) or ECDSA P-256 (SEC1/PKCS#8 DER as `ecPrivateKeyDerBase64`, or raw 32-byte scalar as 64 hex chars in `ecPrivateScalarHex`). DER keys are signed with a native, constant-time `node:crypto` provider (the pure-JS path is used only as a fallback, e.g. for a bare scalar); verification is pure JS. A `data:…;base64,` prefix is tolerated on every base64 input; PEM where DER is expected → `VALIDATION_ERROR` with the openssl remedy. The verify step recomputes ByteRange SHA-256, validates the CMS messageDigest, and verifies the signatureValue against the embedded signer certificate. Use `prepare_signature_placeholder` only when you need to customize the placeholder (e.g. larger `placeholderBytes` for >4096-bit RSA keys, `subFilter: 'ETSI.CAdES.detached'`, `reserveTimestamp: true`). Signer metadata (name / reason / location / contactInfo) is baked into the placeholder.

## PAdES ladder (v1.6.0)

```jsonc
// B-B  : sign_pdf      { profile: "pades", algorithm: "rsa-sha256", ... }
// B-T  : sign_pdf      { ..., timestamp: true }                       // PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL required
// B-LT : add_ltv       { pdfBase64, mode: "online" }                  // PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION + ALLOWED_HOSTS
//        add_ltv       { pdfBase64, mode: "offline", certificatesDerBase64, ocspResponsesDerBase64, crlsDerBase64 }  // zero network
// B-LTA: timestamp_pdf { pdfBase64 }                                   // re-run before the TSA certificate expires
// check: verify_pdf    { pdfBase64, ltv: true }  → ltvLevel, per-signature profile / timestamp / revocation
```

Caveats of `verify_pdf ltv:true`: revocation status is read from embedded /DSS material only (responder signatures are not verified); timestamp tokens are checked for imprint consistency, TSA trust only when its root is in `trustedRootsDerBase64`. Document timestamps count in `allValid` like any signature (sound ⇒ pass, tampered or TSA-untrusted ⇒ fail). timestamp_pdf checks the token's status, imprint and nonce before embedding; the token's own CMS signature is verified by verify_pdf.
